The Most Underrated Bible Study App. Olive Tree is truly one of the most underrated Bible study apps out there. I first found it while searching for an NKJV Bible with Strong’s, and it went far beyond what I expected. What started as a simple search became a serious Bible study library for me Bibles, commentaries, lexicons, theology, exegesis, hermeneutics, ethics, original-language tools, and so much more.

Do not let anyone tell you Olive Tree is only a simple mobile Bible app. Yes, it is excellent on phone and tablet, but if you build your library, it can become a powerful scholarly study tool. Commentaries are not the same as study Bibles, and Olive Tree gives access to many kinds concise, pastoral, technical, exegetical, historical, and multi-volume works. Add in Greek and Hebrew resources, major lexicons, theological dictionaries, study Bibles, language tools, and serious theology, and you have something far deeper than people realize.

I am truly thankful to God for this app and thankful to Olive Tree for making Bible study so accessible across my devices. Their customer service has also been excellent in my experience. Whether you are just starting to read Scripture or building a serious study library, give Olive Tree a real chance. Once you get a taste for deeper Bible study through it, you may not want to switch again. Five stars.
